title: The Curious child at the window
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：curious　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 curious 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1954 the director wrote of ① a curious child at the window in the poster, and everybody in the theatre said at once that it was ② more curious than the one named there the year before. Three nights on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the director, who never explained anything, had done it without a word of thanks and gone home; it was the curious ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most curious child at the window anybody in the theatre had ever seen, or so the poster for August 1948 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too curious to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the actor who had come to help; the curious ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a curious smell in the hall, and said that no actor in his right mind would call it ⑥ as curious as the smell in the hall they had once had in the old theatre. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was curious or not, and he said so.

By 1961 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the poster. What the line asked for was ⑦ something curious, and nothing besides. The actor from the next theatre called the whole plan ⑧ quite curious; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the poster kept the names of the curious ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1964, at once, she wrote of another curious child at the window in the same poster, and the work, which took two nights, seemed ⑨ more curious than anybody had expected. ⑩ The most curious smell in the hall in the whole theatre, she said in 1966, was the one she could never quite name; the curious ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 好奇（前置定语 a curious child at the window：1954 年导演在戏报里记下的那件好奇的孩子）
B. adj. 好奇／古怪（比较级 more curious than：文中两处，一处比窗边的孩子，一处比预想）
C. adj. 好奇／古怪（最高级 the most curious：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 好奇（表语 too curious to do：母亲觉得它太好奇，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 古怪（前置定语 a curious smell in the hall：叔叔把整件事称作一桩古怪的气味）
F. adj. 古怪（同级比较 as curious as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩厅里的气味相比）
G. adj. 古怪（后置定语 something curious：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 古怪（受程度副词修饰 quite curious：那位演员的评价）

items.q: a curious child at the window
the most curious child at the window anybody
a curious smell in the hall
The most curious smell in the hall in

answers.why: curious 意为“好奇”，1954 年导演在戏报里记下的是“一件好奇的孩子”，此处作前置定语 a curious child at the window。
curious 意为“好奇”，此处用比较级 more curious than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
curious 意为“好奇”，戏报上 八月 那行字说它是戏院里最好奇的一件，故用最高级 the most curious child at the window。
curious 意为“好奇”，母亲认为这件东西“太好奇了，谁也用不上”，too curious to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
curious 意为“古怪”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩古怪的气味”，此处作前置定语 a curious smell in the hall。
curious 意为“古怪”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩厅里的气味一样古怪”，同级比较用 as curious as。
curious 意为“古怪”，戏报上那半行字要的是“古怪的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something curious。
curious 意为“古怪”，邻戏院来的那位演员认为这套计划“相当古怪”，quite 修饰原级 curious。
curious 意为“古怪”，1964 年那趟活儿“比任何人预想的都要古怪”，故用比较级 more curious than。
curious 意为“古怪”，母亲 1966 年说的是“整个戏院里最古怪的那一桩”，故用最高级 the most curious smell in the hall。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1954 年，导演在戏报里记下了一件好奇的孩子。（a curious child at the window）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更好奇。（more curious than …）
母亲觉得它太好奇，谁也用不上。（too curious to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩古怪的气味。（a curious smell in the hall）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩厅里的气味一样古怪。（as curious as …）
到了 1961 年，戏报上只剩半行字：要的是一件古怪的东西。（something curious）
answers: In 1954 the director wrote of a curious child at the window in the poster.
Everybody said it was more curious than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too curious to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a curious smell in the hall.
He said nobody would call it as curious as the smell in the hall they had once had.
By 1961 the poster asked for nothing but something curious.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 curious 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1954 the director wrote of a curious child at the window in the poster, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most curious child at the window in the theatre, or so the poster says.
My mother thought it too curious to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a curious smell in the hall, and nobody argued with him.
The actor from the next theatre called the plan quite curious, and everybody laughed.
The curious ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
